title: Tool basics
description: Find, read, write and edit files; small pipelines; recover from a failing command.

cases.title: Find settings.ini, read port
cases.prompt: Somewhere under /workspace there is a file named settings.ini. Find it and reply with only the port number from its [server] section.

setupFiles.content:
# lark

Monorepo for the Lark services. See docs/ for deployment notes.

# Deploying

The api service listens on port 8000 by default unless its settings file says otherwise.

; api settings
[metrics]
port = 9100
enabled = true

[server]
host = 0.0.0.0
port = 8443
workers = 4

[db]
port = 5432

cases.title: Write a 3-line file
cases.prompt:
Create the file /workspace/notes/todo.txt (the notes directory does not exist yet) containing exactly these three lines in this order, and nothing else:
buy milk
call the plumber
renew passport

check.equals:
buy milk
call the plumber
renew passport

cases.title: Edit one config line
cases.prompt: In /workspace/app.conf, change the active max_connections setting from 100 to 250. Leave every other line exactly as it is, including the commented-out line and max_connections_per_ip.

setupFiles.content:
# Lark API server configuration
listen_address = 0.0.0.0
listen_port = 8443

# Connection limits
# max_connections = 50   (old default)
max_connections = 100
max_connections_per_ip = 100
idle_timeout = 30

# Logging
log_level = info
log_file = /var/log/lark/api.log

cases.title: Busiest 5xx client IP
cases.prompt: /workspace/access.log is a web server access log. Which client IP address received the most responses with a 5xx status code (500-599)? Write only that IP address to /workspace/answer.txt.

cases.title: Total size of .png files
cases.prompt: What is the total size in bytes of all files whose names end in .png anywhere under /workspace/assets, including subdirectories? Reply with only the number.

cases.title: Count orders with jq-style filter
cases.prompt: /workspace/data/orders.json holds a JSON array of orders. How many orders have status "shipped" and a total strictly greater than 100? Reply with only the number.

cases.title: Recover from a wrong path
cases.prompt: Read the Q3 2024 summary at /workspace/reports/q3-summary.txt and reply with only the total revenue figure it reports, as a plain number with no currency sign and no commas.

cases.title: Fix bad input, rerun script
cases.prompt: Run `python3 /workspace/tools/mean.py /workspace/data/readings.txt` and save its output (just the number it prints) to /workspace/mean.txt. If the command fails, find the cause and fix the data file by deleting the invalid line(s). Do not modify mean.py.

setupFiles.content:
import sys

vals = [float(line) for line in open(sys.argv[1]) if line.strip()]
print(f"{sum(vals) / len(vals):.2f}")
